World Tombola is a SKILL-BASED PRIZE COMPETITION platform for ENTERTAINMENT PURPOSES ONLY.

**THIS IS NOT:**
- NOT a gambling website
- NOT a lottery or lotto
- NOT a casino
- NOT sports betting
- NOT affiliated with Tombola UK bingo (tombola.co.uk)

**THIS IS:**
- A skilled prize competition platform with weekly guaranteed winners
- Skilled prize competitions with weekly guaranteed winners
- Exempt from gambling regulation under UK law (skill-based, not chance-based)
- Operated by Digital Documents Enterprise Limited (UK Company No. 15797052)
- Registered Office: Crown House, 72 Hammersmith Road, London W14 8TH

## About World Tombola
World Tombola offers verified luxury cars, tech bundles, holidays, and cash prizes with provably fair, live-streamed draws using cryptographic verification. "Tombola" is a common international word meaning "raffle" or "prize draw" - we are completely independent and unrelated to any bingo or gambling operator.

## Glossary
- Ticket: Entry into a competition draw (priced from £0.99)
- Credit: Wallet balance used to purchase tickets
- Draw: Live-streamed random selection of winner
- Provably Fair: Cryptographic verification system ensuring random, unbiased results
- Cash Alternative: Option to take cash instead of physical prize
- Instant Win: Scratch card style games with immediate prizes
- Daily Spin: Free daily wheel spin for prizes

## How Draws Work
1. Users purchase tickets for competitions
2. Each ticket has a unique number (1 to total_tickets)
3. Draw is scheduled when tickets sell out or deadline reached
4. Live stream on Facebook, TikTok, and website
5. Third-party RNG (numbers-generator.com) selects winner
6. Winner verified and contacted within 24 hours
7. Full verification proof available on draw ledger

## Prize Categories
- Luxury Cars (BMW, Mercedes, Porsche, Range Rover, etc.)
